description: This file implements HTTP Range requests handling to support streaming of video files. It includes functions for parsing range headers, generating file chunks, and creating streaming responses for clients requesting partial content.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _parse_range(range_header: Optional[str], file_size: int)
methods.description: Parses the Range header to determine start and end byte positions within a file.

methods.name: Iterator[bytes] _file_chunk_generator(file_path: str, start: int, end: int)
methods.description: Generator that reads specific byte ranges from a file in chunks.

methods.name: Response range_stream_response(file_path: str, filename: Optional[str], range_header: Optional[str], content_type: str = "video/mp4")
methods.description: Creates a StreamingResponse that streams a file supporting HTTP Range requests.
